# endpointcentral_mdm_group (Resource)

An MDM device group: the target of Mac custom profiles. Add devices with `endpointcentral_mdm_group_membership` and profiles with `endpointcentral_mdm_group_profile_assignment`.

The MDM API cannot rename a group, so changing `name` or `description` replaces it, and with it its members and assignments. MDM groups are separate from Endpoint Central custom groups (`endpointcentral_custom_group`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "endpointcentral_mdm_group" "engineering" {
  name        = "engineering-macs"
  description = "Macs with the dev role"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Group name. Changing it replaces the group.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description. Changing it replaces the group.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Group ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
tofu import endpointcentral_mdm_group.engineering 200000000114014
```
